title: Senior visual designer
description:
What is Teachable?Teachable is the platform for experts and businesses who take education seriously. In a world where anyone can ask AI for information, we're the home for those who educate with purpose, modernity, and humanity. We help experts and businesses scale their impact and operations through courses, coaching, and digital downloads that students actually love. From a finance expert teaching Python for investment analysis to a multilingual coach offering business Spanish for executives, Teachable powers human-led learning that drives student trust, connection, and results. With a sleek, intuitive interface and AI as a time-saving partner, the platform enables transformative education rooted in real-world experience. Teachable experts have lived it—that's why they teach it. Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey?
Part of the globalHotmart Companyportfolio,whose platforms have helped creators, experts, and businesses earn more than $10 billion,Teachable continues to cement itself as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize student outcomes, business growth, and flexibility. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of real-world learning to shape the future, we want you on our team!About your teamOur Brand & Content team is a group of social media experts, newsletter writers, designers, copywriters, and event pros—all working together to build a world-class brand creators love. We focus on growing Teachable’s reach, connecting with new and existing audiences, and using content, design, and in-person experiences to drive awareness, generate leads, and deepen engagement.What is the role?We’re looking for a highly creative, results-oriented Brand Designer to join our Brand + Content Team. This role is for a strategic thinker with strong design execution skills and a deep understanding of brand systems. You’ll help shape and scale our visual storytelling, building cohesive brand expressions that drive engagement and recognition across campaigns, events, and experiences.
This role focuses on evolving and extending visual identity systems and applying brand guidelines across digital and physical touchpoints. You’ll design multi-channel marketing assets spanning email, paid media, social, web, and print, with an eye for consistency and craft. The ideal candidate also brings strengths in web and motion design to support a multidisciplinary team.
While an individual contributor role, you’ll collaborate closely with other designers—offering thoughtful critique, feedback, and informal mentorship—and partner cross-functionally to create design that resonates with our audience and reinforces our brand story.In this role, you will:Build upon and evolve brand guidelines by establishing sophisticated visual systems that align with business goals.
Proactively propose solutions to help improve project outcomes across a range of project types, including marketing and product.
Conceptualize and execute high-impact design across diverse formats: digital & print, event identities, promotional assets, and marketing materials that extend the Teachable brand.
Demonstrate versatility in applying design thinking to varied channels while maintaining cohesion across all output.
Foster a collaborative environment and work closely with stakeholders and cross-functional stakeholders including web, product marketing, growth, and events—to ensure creative execution aligns with GTM strategy, brand objectives, and campaign goals.
Provide mentorship to junior designers on the team.
Present creative concepts to teams across the organization in a clear and compelling manner.
Strive to maintain the brand standard across all projects and ensure consistency.
Manage end-to-end production for creative deliverables, including preparing files for presentations, cross functional partners, print vendors, and event production.
Build trusted relationships with cross-functional peers through clear communication, curiosity, and accountability.
Contribute motion design and animation to campaigns, launches, or brand moments that deepen storytelling and audience engagement.
Stay up to date on design trends and tools, with a particular focus on leveraging AI in design workflowsWhat you’ll bring:Experience: 5+ years of visual design experience, with a strong focus on branding and performance marketing
Experience working collaboratively alongside fellow designers and/or offering mentorship/coaching to other designers
Skills: Excels in the Adobe Creative Suite and Figma
Portfolio: A strong portfolio showcasing a diverse range of design projectsand assets (including email, social, paid advertising, print, etc.), plus motion design
Strong design sensibility with attention to detail, typography, and visual storytelling.
Ability to adapt to brand guidelines while pushing creative boundaries;experience refining and scaling brand guidelines.
Strong collaboration skills and ability to work cross-functionally with marketers, designers, and content creators.
Self-starter with excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Understanding: Demonstrated understanding of brand identities, digital marketing principles, website design best practices, and performance marketing metrics.
Communication: Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively communicate design concepts to stakeholders and gather feedback.
Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and adapt to changing priorities.Nice to have:
Experience working in Saa S, edtech, or within the creator economy.
Familiarity with video editing tools (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar).
Knowledge of current trends in motion design, animation, and paid and social media.While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as aremote-first culture

ODoutores Inovando no Setor Empresarialoportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.O programa oferecebolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta aaplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas eminovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula atomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa acapacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.Sobre a Oportunidade:A Terris é uma indústria de tecnologia para agricultura de precisão com sede na cidade de Pato Branco – Paraná, que desde 2015 Desenvolve soluções tecnológicas que visam uma maior produtividade, diminuição de perdas e economia de insumos.
O objetivo deste projeto é Criar, validar e industrializar um módulo nativo de automação agrícola que permita a aplicação precisa e georreferenciada de insumos líquidos, com redução de sobreposição, aumento de eficiência e integração ao ecossistema já existente da empresa.

title: Brazil - remote: tech lead
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.
Job Duties
We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:
Backend:Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
Data:Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
Frontend:Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
Dev Ops:Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.
Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by Dev Ops.What You’ll Do
Technical Orchestration:You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how theBackendserves live telemetry toFrontenddashboards and howData Engineeringpipelines feed theKnowledge Graph.
Code & Quality Standards:Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (Fast API), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
The "Expert":When theDev Opsengineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or theBackendengineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
Team Leadership:Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.Qualifications
Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
10+ yearsof experience in Software Engineering, with at least2+ yearsleading technical teams.
Deep proficiency inPython Backend Development.
Solid understanding ofFrontend complexity(SPA architecture, async data loading).
Experience designing or managingData Intensive Applications(understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
Familiarity withDev Ops/Cloudconcepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
Advanced English communication skills.Good to Have:
Streaming:Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (Timescale DB, Influx DB).
Gen AI:Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (Lang Graph), and Vector Databases.
Graph:Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
Experience withDigital Twins, Io T, or Industrial Data.

title: Resource manager, professional services
description:
CAI is a leading provider of digital work execution platforms designed to enhance operational efficiency and drive productivity in industrial environments. CAI’s platform leverages advanced technology to convert complex, paper-based procedures into streamlined, digital workflows. By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.About us
Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.Position Overview
The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.Core Responsibilities
Resource Planning and Allocation
Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants.Forecasting and Talent Management
Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.Process Optimization and Tool Management
Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.Daily Operational Responsibilities
New Engagement Intake
Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.Assignment & Scheduling
Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.System Sync and Integration Oversight
Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → Net Suite mappings to ensure accuracy.
Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, Net Suite, and Concur.
Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.Time Tracking Oversight
Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.Project Health & Status Monitoring
Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.Reporting & Communication
Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.Performance and Collaboration
Monitor workload balance across consultants.
Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.QualificationsExperience:
4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent verbal and written proficiency with English.Skills:
Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and Net Suite preferred.
Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

title: Inspetor(a) manutenção sênior
description:
Você fará parte de um time técnico estratégico, atuando comoreferência em manutenção preditiva, com foco emanálise avançada de vibração e diagnóstico de máquinas rotativas. Sua atuação será essencial para garantir a confiabilidade dos ativos, apoiar tecnicamente a equipe e disseminar metodologias e boas práticas de análise.
Principais Responsabilidades:
• Realizar inspeções, executar e guiar instalações e manutenção mecânica, elétrica e instrumentação em máquinas e equipamentos de várias complexidades, interpretando manuais, desenhos e esboços, orientando os usuários em dúvida sobre a operação e os recursos.
• Comunicar os resultados de cada inspeção ao superior imediato, de forma apropriada e com detalhes completos, para que as intervenções sejam planejadas para manter o equipamento em ótimas condições de trabalho.
• Desenvolver e participar do cronograma de inspeção de manutenção (rotas), inspecionar o equipamento e o tipo de configuração e a frequência de manutenção, mencionando através de inspeções detectadas anormalidades.
• Inspecionar a instalação de máquinas e equipamentos de várias complexidades, de modo a avaliar as condições operacionais.
• Monitorar e rastrear atividades relacionadas ao campo de manutenção e guiar tecnicamente a equipe quando necessário.
• Verificar, monitorar e controlar o desgaste dos componentes do equipamento, propor melhorias através da verificação sistemática, usando ferramentas apropriadas e registrando as informações, com o objetivo de disponibilidade e aumentar a vida útil do equipamento.
• Leia e interprete desenhos e esboços para manutenção, localização de falhas e falhas do equipamento, usando ferramentas apropriadas de instrumentação e medição.
• Inspecionar as peças, ferramentas e suprimentos de manutenção no recibo do armazém, por meio de conhecimento técnico e ferramentas adequadas para garantir que o material atenda às especificações.
• Garantir a limpeza, a organização do local de trabalho e a manutenção de ferramentas e equipamentos, mantendo -os organizados e limpos para a reutilização, conforme necessário, atendendo às regras e procedimentos.
• Avaliar e implementar melhorias nos sistemas de inspeção, por meio de sugestões como estudos e inspeções.
• Emitir relatório técnico com diagnóstico e recomendações, destinado a apontar as anormalidades para o funcionamento adequado do equipamento e o aumento da vida útil do serviço.
• Atender Solicitações contidas nas ordens de serviço
• Executar planos de monitoramento de equipamentos, componentes ou itens por meio de instrumentação apropriada, como: imagem térmica, endoscopia, vibração e alinhamento, entre outros;
• Desenvolver o diagnóstico do tipo de relatórios de defeitos, e orientar a intervenção das áreas de especialização, quando necessário.
• Participar com a engenharia de manutenção, o desenvolvimento de relatórios de análise de falhas
• Garantir o uso adequado das ferramentas disponíveis, como câmera, computadores e equipamentos de análise sensível e preditivos
• Desenvolver relatórios de análise de vibração, fornecendo aconselhamento técnico para apoiar decisões e gerenciamento da equipe de manutenção
• Seguir as regras atendendo aos requisitos de sistemas de gestão da qualidade, padrões ambientais e de segurança de trabalho inerentes ao setor e ao uso de EPP / EPC (equipamento de proteção pessoal / equipamento de proteção coletiva) quando a atividade requer, para garantir o Integridade física dos funcionários.
• Identificar qualquer avaria em equipamentos, mesmo na inspeção sensitiva, abrir nota e comunicar imediatamente o setor responsável;
• Desenvolver outras atividades do escritório ou a critério de seu superior imediato, para atender às demandas e seu crescimento profissionalRequisitos Técnicos:
Formação técnica ou superior na área industrial/mecânica (ou correlata).
Conhecimento em equipamentos mecânicos, com foco emmáquinas rotativas(nível médio a avançado).
Experiência comprovada em coleta e análise de vibração.
Certificação em Análise de Vibração – Nível 1 e 2.Vivência prática com:
Sistemas de análise de vibração.

Experiência emmanutenção preditiva, inspeção técnica e/ou confiabilidade.

title: Analista de estratégia financeira
description:
Seja bem-vindo(a) à página do Sicoob Engecred!Há 25 anos no mercado financeiro, o Sicoob Engecred figura entre as maiores cooperativas do Sistema Sicoob, com R$ 4,2 bilhões em ativos totais e cerca de 25 mil cooperados em todas as regiões do país, por meio da associação digital.
Temos em nosso DNA o interesse genuíno pelas pessoas, seja dentro da cooperativa – o que nos levou a conquistar 19 premiações em rankings regionais e nacionais do Great Place to Work (GPTW) -, ou junto aos nossos associados, oferecendo soluções financeiras adequadas e com taxas justas. Isto sem falar nos benefícios que geramos nas comunidades onde atuamos, fomentando negócios e promovendo diversas ações sociais por meio do Instituto Sicoob.
Classificada como A+(bra) pela Fitch Ratings, a instituição tem seus números auditados pela Deloitte. Em 2024, se tornou a primeira cooperativa do Sistema Sicoob, em Goiás, a conquistar a Categoria Plena pelo Banco Central e, também, a obter o selo Empresa Limpa, feitos que reforçam sua credibilidade e postura ética.Com sede em Goiânia (GO), atualmente possui agências físicas em Goiás e Minas Gerais, além de escritórios de negócios em Betim (MG), Juiz de Fora (MG), Brasília (DF), Campo Grande (MS), Campinas (SP) e São Paulo (SP).Seguimos em busca de soluções e experiências inovadoras e sustentáveis para, por meio da cooperação, viabilizar o desenvolvimento econômico e social de comunidades.Junte-se a nós, faça parte desta jornada de sucesso!Analista de Estratégia FinanceiraRequisitos:
Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas afins;
Vivência prévia em tesouraria, estratégia financeira, controladoria ou áreas correlatas;
Conhecimento em precificação, análise de rentabilidade e conceitos de risco financeiro;
Possuir CEA.
Descrição das Atividades:
Estruturar, manter e evoluir modelos de precificação de produtos e operações financeiras, considerando custo de funding, despesas, risco, capital e estratégia comercial;
Desenvolver e aplicar metodologias de retorno ajustado ao risco (Raroc), apoiando decisões de alocação de capital, definição de spreads e priorização de negócios;
Estruturar e manter análises de ALM (Asset & Liability Management), incluindo simulações de cenários, impactos de liquidez, sensibilidade a taxas de juros e equilíbrio entre ativos e passivos;
Conectar as análises financeiras da Tesouraria ao planejamento estratégico da cooperativa, traduzindo diretrizes estratégicas em parâmetros financeiros e indicadores mensuráveis;
Desenvolver estudos e análises de apoio à tomada de decisão estratégica, incluindo cenários, projeções e avaliação de impactos econômico-financeiros;
Apoiar a definição e revisão de políticas financeiras, metodologias de precificação e critérios de rentabilidade;
Atuar de forma integrada com as demais áreas da cooperativa.

title: Sales engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, and Brazilian office in Barueri, SP, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 355 systems supplied into 28 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together.
The Sales Engineer plays a key role in achieving sales targets for Greenlane’s biogas desulfurization and upgrading systems by combining strong technical expertise with commercial acumen. title: Senior splunk engineer
description:
OverviewWe are seeking an experienced Senior Splunk Engineer to take over and operate the on-premise Splunk SIEM platform. As part of the transition from Infosys, you will be responsible for stabilizing and continuously improving an existing enterprise-scale SIEM environment.You will own all Splunk operations across Plan & Build, 24/7 Operations, Release & Patch Management, CIM-based Log Onboarding, Parser development, Hardening, Configuration Management, and Incident/Problem/Change processes.Responsibilities
1. Plan & Build
Perform CIM-compliant log onboarding, parser creation, documentation.
Conduct onboarding due diligence and demand analysis.
Create Firewall/VPN/Routing change requests and validate changes.
Manage ingestion pipelines via Cribl, Syslog-ng (TLS), Splunk UF/HF, SCP.
Deploy and scale Splunk components using Terraform and Ansible.
Build trend and capacity analyses.2. Operations (24/7 enterprise-grade operations)
Ensure full Splunk platform operation, monitoring, performance, EPS/log flow.
Handle Incidents, Service Requests, Changes, and Problems under MBG ITSM.
Lead Major Incident Management (P1/P2) with 24/7 on-call rotation.
Build and operate Health Check dashboards and QA reports.3. Configuration & Release Management
Implement approved changes across Splunk components.
Perform daily configuration backups (KV stores, Apps, Configs).
Maintain automation libraries (Terraform, Ansible, scripts).
Manage Splunk patching and releases (maintain N-1 level).
Support up to 12 minor + 1 major release per year.4. Security, Hardening & Compliance
System hardening and vulnerability remediation.
Operate via secure access methods (Jump hosts, Su SSHi, 2 FA).
Conduct vulnerability scans and support SOC threat analysis.
Automate SOP-based operational workflows.5. Transition
Take over existing MBG Splunk operations.
Validate and enhance current configurations, parsers, and deployments.
Ensure stability during transition and hypercare.Requirements
Technical Skills
5–10 years Splunk/SIEM experience in large enterprises.
Expertise in Splunk Architecture, CIM onboarding, parser development, Syslog-ng, certificates.
Strong scripting: Terraform, Ansible, Bash/Python.
Experience stabilizing existing SIEM environments.Certifications (required)
Minimum two of:
Splunk Core Certified User
Splunk Core Certified Power User
Splunk Enterprise Admin
Splunk Enterprise Architect
Optional: Splunk ESSoft Skills
Strong communication in enterprise environments.
Clear documentation skills.
Proactive, quality-driven work style.
Fluent English (German beneficial).

title: Graphic designer
description:
Company DescriptionEMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now Saa S products.
We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.
We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.You Are
An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and Saa S-oriented design work.Role DescriptionThis is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.
You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing Saa S initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.
Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.
Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.Responsibilities
Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
Support video and social content with strong visual design
Contribute to UX/UI design for Saa S and internal software products
Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without frictionQualifications
Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
Experience with branding, logo design, and typography

Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
Attention to detail and strong design judgment
Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
Fluent in English, written and spoken

title: Devops engineer - sr. associate
description:
About the CompanyCredit Saison Brazil ("CSBR") is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.
Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan's largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.
Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.
About the Role
Cloud Infrastructure & Orchestration
Architect and manage container platforms (AWS ECS or EKS) ensuring scalability, high availability, and fault tolerance critical for financial transactions.
Implement Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) using Terraform or Cloud Formation to standardize environments and ensure reproducibility across development, staging, and production.
Manage AWS Networking components (VPCs, Subnets, Transit Gateways, Route 53, Load Balancers) with a focus on network segregation and security best practices.
CI/CD & Automation
Design and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines to support agile software delivery while enforcing strict quality gates and security checks.
Automate operational tasks using Python or Bash to reduce manual intervention and operational risk.
Drive the "Shift-Left" approach, integrating testing and security scanning early in the development lifecycle.
Observability, Reliability & Performance
Configure and maintain comprehensive observability solutions (APM, dashboards, distributed tracing, and centralized logging) to ensure real-time visibility into system health.
Proactively monitor application performance and infrastructure metrics to prevent incidents and optimize resource utilization.
Define and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Error Budgets to maintain the reliability required for a 24/7 financial operation.
Security, Compliance & Governance
Ensure secure container lifecycles, managing ECR (Image Registry) with strict vulnerability scanning and patching routines for third-party and internal images.
Implement security controls and access management (IAM) aligned with financial regulatory standards (e. G., BACEN, LGPD) and audit requirements.
Collaborate with the Security team to implement immutable infrastructure and ensure audit trails for all infrastructure changes.
Requirements
Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese and Professional English (technical reading and writing are essential).
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of experience in Dev Ops, SRE, or Cloud Engineering roles.
Solid knowledge of Python and proficiency in Terraform and/or AWS Cloud Formation.
Deep proficiency in Docker, container orchestration (ECS or EKS), and Helm.
Experience with AWS networking architecture and security groups.
Practical experience with APM tools (e. G., Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace) and logging stacks (ELK, Splunk, Cloud Watch).
Differentiators (Nice to have)
AWS Certified Dev Ops Engineer Professional or Solutions Architect Professional.
CKA/CKAD (Kubernetes) Certification.
Prior experience in the Financial Sector (Fin Techs, Banks, Payments), specifically dealing with regulatory requirements and critical mission environments.
Experience with Git Ops workflows (e. G., Argo CD).

title: Tax sr. associate
description:
About the CompanyCredit Saison Brazil ("CSBR") is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.
Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan's largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.
Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.
About the Role
Tax Calculation & Compliance:
Expertise in the calculation and review of all major federal taxes: IRPJ/CSLL (Annual/Quarterly Actual Profit Lucro Real and Presumed Profit Lucro Presumido), and PIS/COFINS (Cumulative and Non-Cumulative regimes).
Deep knowledge of federal withholding taxes (IRRF, CSRF, INSSRF) and their accounting reconciliation.
Experience with tax benefits and fiscal incentives + Tax Credits.
Auxiliary Obligations
Extensive experience in the preparation, review, and timely submission of federal and state Tax obligations, including: DCTF, ECF, EFD Contributions, EFD Reinf, ECD, Per/Dcomp, GIA, SPED Fiscal, E-financeira, Dimp.
Tax Credits & Recovery:
Proven track record in identifying and processing tax credits, including claims for undue or overpayment, IRPJ/CSLL negative balances, and PIS/COFINS credits (Restitution and Reimbursement requests).
Audit & Litigation Support
Experience managing the Tax Audit calendar and serving as the primary point of contact for external audits.
Ability to analyze and respond to official notices, subpoenas (intimações), decision-making orders (despachos decisórios), and internal preliminary tax reviews from the Brazilian Federal Revenue (Receita Federal do Brasil).
Tax Planning & Strategy:
Knowledge of Transfer Pricing (specifically for Services) and the ability to act as a Tax Business Partner to internal controls (risk management) and international finance teams (supporting international expansion, and local registration,).
Financial Reconciliation: Advanced skill in performing detailed fiscal cross-checks (ECF x EFD Contribuições x DCTF x Apurações x DARFs) and reconciling tax-related general ledger accounts (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, IRRF, PCC).
Collaboration & Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative attitude, focused on sharing knowledge, working effectively in a team environment, and ensuring effective internal customer service.
Requirements
Over 10 years of progressive experience in the fiscal and tax field, with expertise gained across diverse sectors including: Technology/Services and Finance.
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Law and specialization/Post-Graduate certification in Taxation.
Advanced proficiency and practical expertise in leading ERP systems
Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese & English (both verbal and written)
Able to commute to the office in Sao Paulo a few times a week
Knowledge in Brazilian Tax regulation
Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel
Well-rounded understanding and mindset in corporate governance pertaining to Brazilian central Bank
Preferred Competencies:
Process Automation & Design: Experience in the automation of tax and P2 P processes (invoice receipt, payment, tax calculation, and ancillary obligations) and in the mapping/design of corporate tax processes and policies.
Project Management & Coordination: Demonstrated ability to manage complex tax projects, coordinate team activities, and monitor performance using Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

title: Senior procurement specialist (indirect products)
description:
Job Title: Senior Procurement Specialist (Indirect Products) – LAMLocation: Brazil (able to travel around LAM countries)
Employment Type: Full-TimeJob Overview
We are seeking an experienced Senior Procurement Specialist to lead indirect products procurement activities especially third party products procurement across LAM. The ideal candidate will possess deep industry expertise, strong supply chain management skills, and fluency in English to drive cross-regional collaboration, ensuring efficient and compliant procurement processes that align with company strategic goals.Key Responsibilities
1 Supplier Development & Management
Identify, evaluate, and onboard indirect products’ suppliers across LAM and globally, ensuring compliance and performance alignment.
Conduct regular supplier assessments (quality, cost, delivery) to optimize supply chain resilience.
2 Strategic Sourcing & Negotiation
Develop and execute procurement strategies for different product categories, leading negotiations on pricing, contracts, payment terms and delivery terms to achieve cost-saving targets.
Manage Long-Term Agreements (LTAs) in compliance with local regulations and corporate policies.
3 Procurement Execution & Documentation
Oversee end-to-end procurement processes, including purchase order (PO) drafting and issuance, delivery coordination, goods receipt coordination, installation and acceptance coordination, payment documentation follow-up and procurement related documentation archiving.
Ensure seamless order fulfillment: Track deliveries, resolve discrepancies with suppliers/warehouse teams, and maintain accurate records in OA, ERP systems (e.g., SAP).
Validate compliance: Verify product specifications during goods acceptance and ensure invoices align with contractual terms before payment approval.
4 Compliance & Risk Mitigation
Ensure adherence to local regulations depending on product categories, e.g. Medical Device Regulation, ISO 13485 standards, and internal compliance protocols.

title: Sr. data analytics engineer
description:
About CredixCredixis a Fin Tech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2 B transactions in Brazil with our platform,Credi Pay. Credi Pay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.Why choose Credix?
Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.About the job
We are looking for someone to join Credix as a aSenior Analytics Engineer. You will take ownership of structuring our data analytics platform and analytics use-cases. You love to tackle big problems and break them down into smaller pieces. You will build an analytics platform that features reliable, timely and understandable metrics in a slice-and-dice format to empower other teams to make better decisions.Responsibilities
Design and maintain dbt models and reliable datasets that power analytics, experiments, and decision-making across the company.
Define and act upon standards for metrics, data modeling practices, and documentation.
Oversee the full analytics lifecycle, from transforming raw to delivering insights in BI platforms (e.g. Hex).
Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure analytics pipelines meet high standards of quality, observability and testing.
Enable self-service analytics by creating semantic layers and reusable data assets that let teams create insights independently.Qualifications
5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical data role.
Deep expertise with SQL and dbt, including modular modeling, documentation, and testing.
Proven track record of building source-of-truth data models that support product use cases.
Experience with cloud data warehouses (Big Query), semantic layers (dbt), version control (Git), and visualization tools (Hex).
Experience in a (credit) Fin Tech is a must.
Manager of one: structuring, and executing upon the analytics roadmap.
Analytical and system-oriented mindset with a strong problem-solving ability to handle complex data challenges.
Proactive, clear and concise communication both in Portuguese and English, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams.
Anticipate business metrics needs and structure the analytics layer to ensure scalability and reusability across the entire company.
High attention to detail and a perfectionist approach, especially in maintaining metrics quality and integrity.
Thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment.
Genuine interest/passion for disrupting the B2 B credit market in Brazil by using data.
Collaborative mindset, working effectively with diverse stakeholders.What we offer
Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:
- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Sdr - representante de desenvolvimento de vendas
description:
Sobre a Piece
Somos um grupo de marcas de infoproduto e tecnologia que já somaR$ 15 milhões/anoem receita no portfólio. Temos operação presencial emSão José dos Campos e estamos acelerando para atingir R$ 60 milhões de receita em 2026.Vemos a convergência dos dois dos mercados mais aquecidos do mundo —IA e Creator Economy.De um lado, o software oferece infraestrutura, tecnologia e receita recorrente, mas carece de distribuição e demanda capital. Do outro, creators/infoprodutores possuem audiência massiva, confiança e comunidades engajadas, geram muito caixa, porém com menor visão de longo prazo e poucoLTV.Nossa tese é unir o melhor desses dois mundos para construir um conglomerado global de empresas na intersecção de infoproduto e tecnologia.Acreditamos que os próximos gigantes da América Latina surgirão dessa convergência.Nosso momento é de crescimento acelerado, e estamos construindo as bases financeiras que sustentarão esse crescimento. Nosso ambiente é dinâmico, colaborativo e orientado a resultados. Valorizamos pessoas que aprendem rápido, questionam o status quo e transformam complexidade em clareza.O Desafio / O que você fará:
Estamos em busca de umSDR (Sales Development Representative)para ser o motor de crescimento daPiece Digital. Procuramos um profissional resiliente, com excelente comunicação e "sangue nos olhos", capaz de transformar listas de contatos em oportunidades reais de negócio.
O perfil ideal é de alguém que não tem medo do "não", que possui uma escuta ativa apurada e que entenda que o sucesso do Closer começa em uma qualificação bem feita. Você será a primeira linha de contato com nossos potenciais clientes, sendo o responsável por transmitir confiança e autoridade desde o primeiro segundo.
O SDR terá autonomia para aprimorar abordagens e será peça-chave na escala da nossa operação comercial. Você trabalhará em um ambiente de alta performance, com foco total em abertura de portas e geração de agenda para o time de vendas.O que você vai fazer:
Prospecção Ativa (Outbound):Identificar e abordar potenciais clientes através de Cold Calls, Social Selling (Linked In) e E-mails personalizados.
Qualificação de Leads:Aplicar metodologias de qualificação (como BANT ou SPIN Selling) para entender se o lead possui o perfil ideal (ICP) e o momento de compra correto.
Gestão de Pipeline:Organizar sua rotina no CRM para garantir que nenhum lead fique sem acompanhamento (follow-up) e que o fluxo de agendamentos seja constante.
Quebra de Objeções:Atuar de forma consultiva para contornar os primeiros "nãos" e despertar o interesse genuíno no tomador de decisão.
Parceiro do Closer:Atuar em total sintonia com os executivos de vendas, garantindo que as reuniões agendadas cheguem com o máximo de contexto e informações estratégicas possíveis.Requisitos:
Experiência prévia com prospecção ativa (Outbound) e vendas por telefone/vídeo.
Domínio de ferramentas de produtividade eCRM(Pipedrive, Hubspot ou similares).
Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita (capacidade de criar narrativas rápidas e persuasivas).
Mentalidade de crescimento (Growth Mindset) e resiliência para lidar com metas diárias de atividades.
Competências comportamentais:Organização extrema, alto poder de persuasão, perfil analítico para entender métricas de conversão e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe.Diferenciais:
Experiência em vendas de serviços digitais ou tecnologia (Saa S).
Domínio de ferramentas de inteligência de dados (Lusha, Apollo, etc.).
Treinamentos específicos em metodologias de vendas (Receita Previsível, Challenger Sale, etc.).

title: Analista de engenharia de dados pleno
description:
Buscamos um profissional com perfil \"End-to-End\" para atuar nainterseção entre Engenharia de Dados e Business Intelligence. Sua missão será conectar o
mundo técnico do Databricks com a camada de decisão no Power BI. Você não apenas
validará os dados, mas atuará na construção das tabelas finais (Gold Layer) e no
desenvolvimento de dashboards performáticos, garantindo que a visualização reflita com
precisão as regras de negócio de Mídia.
Principais atribuições:
• Atuar na engenharia e modelagem de dados no Databricks (SQL/Py Spark), realizando transformação de dados e criação/otimização de views e tabelas na camada Gold.
• Desenvolver e manter modelagens dimensionais (Star Schema/Snowflake) para garantir performance e eficiência no consumo via Power BI.
• Implementar e automatizar regras de negócio diretamente na origem, estruturando cálculos e tratamentos para eliminar ajustes manuais no Power Query.
• Criar dashboards executivos e operacionais no Power BI com alto padrão visual, storytelling e melhores práticas de UX/UI.
• Desenvolver medidas avançadas em DAX para análises complexas, incluindo KPIs de mídia como Year-over-Year, Share of Voice e indicadores acumulados.
• Realizar manutenção evolutiva de relatórios existentes, assegurando consistência técnica e visual conforme novas demandas do negócio surgirem.
• Conduzir análises e troubleshooting ponta a ponta, investigando divergências desde medidas DAX até queries SQL no Data Lake.
• Gerenciar governança dos workspaces no Power BI Service, incluindo organização de publicações, controle de acessos e atualização de datasets.
Requisitos
• Power BI em nível intermediário, com domínio de linguagem DAX, conhecimento em Power Query (M) e forte experiência em modelagem de dados (relacionamentos, cardinalidade, desempenho e otimização de datasets).
• SQL em nível intermediário/avançado, com habilidade para escrever queries complexas, incluindo CTEs e Window Functions, para manipulação de dados e validação de regras de negócio.
• Experiência intermediária com Databricks e Py Spark, incluindo uso de notebooks, leitura de tabelas Delta e manipulação básica de Data Frames (filtro, agregações e tratamentos via código).
• Entendimento sólido de pipelines de dados, compreendendo as etapas de ingestão, tratamento e visualização, e sabendo identificar onde atuar quando ocorre alguma falha no fluxo.
Diferenciais:
• Vivência com dados de marketing digital e mídia (Google Ads, Meta, DV360, entre outras plataformas).
• Conhecimento em Python para criação de scripts auxiliares.

description:
About the RoleWe are looking for a Legal & Compliance professional to support our growing business in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment. Prepare compliance reports and support regulatory filings when required;

Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal compliance policies.

Ability to manage multiple matters simultaneously and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment;
Background in legal contract analysis and negotiation, particularly in technology or Saa S contexts;
Knowledge or experience in compliance activities, including AML/CTF, transaction monitoring, and due diligence processes;
Strong analytical and research skills related to legal and regulatory matters;
High attention to detail, sound judgment, and strong sense of responsibility;
Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
We Appreciate
Experience in the virtual assets, blockchain, cryptoassets, or fintech space;
Exposure to regulated environments and interaction with regulators or regulatory frameworks;
Understanding of digital asset business models, regulatory risks, and compliance obligations;
Experience working in fast-growing or scale-up environments.

title: Thumbnail designer (art director) - crypto media
description:
We are the world’s No.1 LIVE Crypto Streaming Channel, covering Bitcoin, breaking news, altcoins, market moves, and the biggest names in the industry — every single day. From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top You Tube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto. Today, with 80+ team members and over 10 M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!
Role Overview
Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.What you’ll do
Lead and Scale the Creative Squad:Direct a high-performance design team of three, managing the end-to-end execution of daily visual assets while collaborating with the Lead Art Director to maintain "Brilliance or Nothing" standards.
Conceptualise Viral Storytelling:Translate complex crypto news, market shifts, and "breaking" narratives into punchy, high-CTR You Tube thumbnails that encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching and urgent manner possible.
Rapid News Translation & Relay:Spearhead daily morning briefing calls to digest the latest market moves and breaking stories, immediately distilling these insights into actionable creative briefs for the design team.
Optimise for Performance & CTR:Apply a deep understanding of You Tube’s backend mechanics and audience psychology to create assets that win the "click" by a mile, ensuring all packaging is impactful and market-relevant.
Operationalise Design Workflows:Build and maintain a seamless, efficient design process that can withstand the intense time constraints of a live streaming environment, ensuring every show asset is ready for the "Stream Team" before go-live.
Cross-Functional Creative Direction:Provide expert art direction and execution for diverse auxiliary projects across the media network, ensuring a consistent and "elite" visual identity across all platforms.Your skills and experience
Visual Storytelling and Execution:Proven ability to turn complex crypto narratives and "breaking" market news into high-impact You Tube thumbnails that are simple, urgent, and designed to win the click.
Crypto Fluency and Market Literacy:A deep-rooted "fellow degen" mentality with a daily obsession for watching the charts, following altcoins, and tracking the world’s biggest market moves.
Creative Leadership and Briefing:Experienced in leading and managing international design teams, with the ability to relay complex daily stories into clear, actionable creative briefs for rapid execution.
You Tube Psychology and Backend Mastery:A strong understanding of You Tube mechanics, specifically focusing on click-through rates (CTR) and audience retention strategies used by top-tier crypto and finance channels.
High-Velocity Performance:Exceptional ability to work under intense pressure and tight time constraints, delivering production-ready assets for live shows on a daily basis.
Strategic Communication and Copywriting:Sharp copywriting skills used to craft titles and visual hooks that capture attention while maintaining transparency and brand integrity

title: Hr operations & analytics analyst
description:
This position is for work in an on-site format, in Contagem - MG.
Who will you be working with?
We are team of curious, passionate, process efficient, customer centric HR professionals! We are driving a global HR operations transformation for Wabtec that will position the HR function to shift towards best in class for HR Service Delivery.
The responsibility of HR Operations & Analytics Analyst is to oversee the administrative and transactional elements of human resources, ensuring that HR processes operate smoothly and align with organizational objectives. This encompasses the management of employee data, payroll, benefits administration (including Car Lease and Medical Insurance), compliance, and support of data quality, onboarding, offboarding, retirals and employee inquiries. In essence, it involves managing the daily operations that ensure the HR department functions effectively.
The team collaborates closely with HR Business Partners to foster positive employee relations by implementing effective, efficient, and reliable HR strategies and practices that align with the Global HR Operation model, ensuring adherence to processes and policies while maintaining compliance with employment laws.
Additionally, the team works in partnership with other Centers of Expertise (such as Talent Acquisition, HRIS, HRDP, Compensation & Benefits, and Legal) to design and implement HR business processes.How will you make a difference?
The HR Operations & Analytics Analyst is part of the HR Shared Services Team. The role is responsible for operational and system support for employee lifecycle transactions and Payroll support within Brazil, Chile and México. The individual will work closely with the other members of the HR Ops team to ensure strong customer service to the business and to drive efficiency by leveraging established processes and guides to transact and answers HR inquiries.What do we want to know about you?
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Accounting, Information Systems, or relevant field.
Advanced English level.
Solid knowledge of Power BI, including data modeling, dashboard creation, and report analysis.
Preferred Qualifications
Ability to provide outstanding customer service by leveraging established processes to transact and respond to inquiries.
Experience working within HR systems, preferably Workday.
Experience with ticketing systems such as Service Now.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, with intermediate/advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, charts, VLOOKUPs).
Knowledge of process automation using tools such as Power Automate, Python, or similar technologies.
Experience in Human Resources, preferably in a Shared Services, HR Operations and/or Payroll environment.What will your typical day look like?
Execute employee lifecycle transactions in Workday; ensure timely processing of the transactions. (Onboarding, Offboarding and Changes in General).
Support payroll processing as needed: work with payroll vendor to deliver the payments for Brazil, Chile and México.
Identify opportunities to improve HR Ops & Payroll processes and participate in continuous improvement projects.
Build network within HR / HRSS organizations and act as a first point of contact for HR Managers.
Prepare and deliver on-boarding / off-boarding documents.
Other projects and duties as assigned.Benefits:

title: It operations manager
description:
We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning: Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization. IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects. Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies. Our Core Focuses: End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity. Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs. Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices. We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.
Job Responsibilities:
1. Responsible for the comprehensive operation and maintenance management of IT infrastructure (including but not limited to servers, networks, storage, and related software platforms) within large-scale operational environments in the Americas region.
2. Develop and implement IT operation strategies, procedures, and standards (SOPs) to ensure the efficient, stable, and secure operation of IT systems, in compliance with internal and external regulations.
3. Manage the IT operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, team development, and daily management, to enhance team professionalism and efficiency.
4. Lead IT incident management, event response, change management, and problem-solving processes to ensure high availability and business continuity of IT systems.
5. Drive the IT operations' transformation towards automation and intelligence, introducing advanced technologies and tools to continuously optimize operational processes, efficiency, and quality.
6. Responsible for IT infrastructure capacity planning, performance monitoring, and optimization to ensure resource allocation meets business growth demands.
7. Manage IT-related vendors and third-party service providers, ensuring their service quality and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.
8. Responsible for IT operations budget planning, cost control, and analysis of technology investment returns.
9. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., Facilities, Asset Management, Security, Business Units) to ensure IT operations effectively support overall business objectives.
10. Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, supporting the evolution of IT architecture to enhance technological competitiveness.

Através das nossas duas marcas, Copagaz e Liquigás, respondemos por 25% da distribuição de Gás Liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP) do Brasil. Possuímos operações em 25 estados e Distrito Federal e cerca de 90 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos. Sendo a maior empresa no segmento de GLP da América Latina. Somos uma empresa privada, que está presente em milhares de lares desde os anos 50. Além disso, fazemos parte do seleto grupo de investidas Itau SA.Estamos em busca de um(a)Analista de Soluções Sr. - RH Digital, para atuar em nosso time deSoluções RHna região doMorumbi.Responsabilidades e atribuições:Atuar como elo integrador entre RH e TI, fortalecendo a eficiência e a qualidade das soluções tecnológicas aplicadas à gestão de pessoas. Traduzir demandas do RH em requisitos técnicos claros e apoiar a TI na compreensão dos contextos e necessidades do negócio, garantindo alinhamento, fluidez na execução e valorização do trabalho conjunto.
Promover a colaboração entre as áreas, assegurando que as soluções digitais para RH sejam concebidas, implementadas e sustentadas com aderência, precisão, segurança e foco em resultado.Garantir clareza técnica e consistência nas demandas de tecnologia do RH, traduzindo as necessidades funcionais dos times de RH em requisitos técnicos completos, estruturados e aderentes às práticas da TI, desde o levantamento de necessidades até a documentação final, assegurando que as solicitações cheguem à TI com clareza;
Conduzir o processo de priorização, solicitação e acompanhamento das soluções digitais de RH, aplicando uma visão integrada de processos e tecnologia, mapeando jornadas, identificando pontos de dor e propondo melhorias;
Desenvolver e manter uma matriz de requisitos técnicos e funcionais das soluções de RH documentando fluxos, integrações, regras de negócio e critérios de aceite de forma padronizada. Responsável por atualizar e versionar a matriz a cada evolução de sistema, assegurando rastreabilidade e clareza para usuários, fornecedores e TI.
Avaliar e recomendar fornecedores, ferramentas e tecnologias aplicáveis ao ecossistema de RH. realizando benchmarking de mercado, provas de conceito e análises comparativas de custo-benefício;
Gerenciar o portfólio de projetos de tecnologia e automação do RH, consolidando o pipeline de iniciativas digitais, acompanhando status, riscos, interdependências e impactos orçamentários;
Monitorar e controlar o orçamento de OPEX e CAPEX relacionado às soluções digitais de RH;
Antecipar e mitigar riscos técnicos, operacionais e de integração nos sistemas de RH;
Apoiar a TI na tradução técnica e na contextualização das soluções para o RH;
Propor e testar novas tecnologias e tendências aplicáveis ao RH, sobre inovações do mercado de HR Tech, IA, analytics e automação de processos;
Disseminar boas práticas e fortalecer a governança dos sistemas e processos digitais de RH.Requisitos e qualificações:Graduação completa em Administração, Engenharia, Tecnologia da informação ou áreas correlatas;
Pós-graduação em Gestão de Projetos ou Tecnologia da informação ou afins;
Experiência em gestão de projetos (cascata e ágil), metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e ferramentas de gestão de projetos;
Integração de Sistemas e Arquitetura de Soluções de sistemas de RH, com noções de APIs, fluxos de integração entre sistemas de RH;
Experiência com documentação Técnica e Funcional, com elaboração de requisitos, matriz de integração, regras de negócio e critérios de aceite;
Governança de Sistemas e Segurança da Informação: princípios de compliance, LGPD;
Experiência em gestão de projetos de tecnologia;
Excel Avançado e Noções de BI;
Inglês intermediário.Desejável:Conhecimento em HR Tech e Tendências Digitais (inteligência Artificial, automação de processos, analytics aplicado ao RH, etc.);
Experiência com RFI/RFP e Homologação de Sistemas, com avaliação técnica e negociação com fornecedores;
Noções de UI, UX e Design Thinking;
Ferramentas de BI e Analytics (Power BI, Tableau).Tipo de contratação:Efetivo - CLT - Modelo Híbrido

É assim que construímos um ambiente íntegro, diverso e inclusivo.Por aqui, acreditamos que um ambiente plural é fundamental para o crescimento da Copa Energia e da nossa sociedade como um todo. title: Analista desenv farmacotécnico sr
description:
Já pensou em fazer parte de uma das maiores indústrias farmacêuticas da América Latina?A Blau é uma indústria farmacêutica líder no segmento hospitalar e pioneira em biotecnologia, com portfólio proprietário de medicamentos de alta complexidade com foco em segmentos relevantes na indústria, como imunologia, hematologia, oncologia, especialidades, antibióticos em diversas classes, entre outros.
A Blau possui footprint continental, presente em 6 países da América Latina e nos Estados Unidos e possui um moderno complexo industrial farmacêutico, composto por cinco plantas industriais, com tecnologia de ponta, dedicadas à produção de medicamentos biológicos, biotecnológicos, oncológicos, antibióticos, anestésicos injetáveis e insumos biotecnológicos.Dia a dia da oportunidade
Realizar levantamento bibliográfico completo, a partir de pesquisa de monografias farmacopeicas, DMFs (Drug Master File), artigos científicos e demais bibliografias para realização de suporte à produção.
Realizar a transferência de tecnologia de lotes para lançamento, visando à fabricação de lotes industriais, com o objetivo de adquirir experiência em novos produtos na linha de produção.
Realizar e dar suporte na elaboração/revisão de documentos e execução de lotes de bancada a lotes industriais, visando inclusão de novos fabricantes alternativos de Insumos para obtenção de registro com dois ou mais fabricantes.
Realizar e dar suporte na avaliação de documentos e testes farmacotécnicos, visando inclusão de novos fabricantes de excipientes para obter dois ou mais fabricantes alternativos.
Elaborar/revisar procedimentos internos inerentes ao setor, com a finalidade de cumprir com as boas práticas de fabricação e de desenvolvimento.
Fazer a interface com fornecedores de excipientes, buscando atualização e informações pertinentes aos trabalhos realizados com intuito de chegar ao objetivo com rapidez e qualidade;
Elaborar e conduzir fluxo de controle de mudanças e mapeamento das atividades/impactos com diversas áreas da companhia;
Realizar avaliações de Due Diligence, para dar suporte aos projetos de licenciamento;
Elaborar respostas de exigências e demais peticionamentos regulatórios para ANVISA e países LATAM;
Prestar suporte para o setor de SAC.O que esperamos que você tenha para concorrer a essa oportunidade:
Graduação completa em Farmácia ou Biotecnologia.
Inglês intermediário a avançado (necessário);
Espanhol intermediário (desejável) ;
Experiência prévia na área de Desenvolvimento Farmacotécnico, preferencialmente em Indústria Farmacêutica com Portfólio.;
Conhecimento de legislações de pós registro de medicamentos;
Desejável conhecimento de guias internacionais (ICH) e fluxo de registro de medicamentos ;

title: Analista de planejamento
description:

Análise das datas e a devida atualização no sistema, bem como informar Customer Services em caso de problemas / atrasos;
Elaboração do forecast mensal de materiais para atendimento dos Pedidos de Venda em carteira. Realizar o acompanhamento para garantir o atendimento conforme previsão.Quem você é:
Você prepara conteúdo para comunicação que seja impactante. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente. Você facilita um diálogo aberto com uma ampla variedade de colaboradores e partes interessadas.Para este cargo, você precisará:
Formado(a) em Administração/Engenharia Produção ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência comprovada em Planejamento de Materiais e Produção;
Experiência com sistema ERP (SAP, Oracle, etc.). Preferencialmente Oracle;
Conhecimento mandatório pacote Office, principalmente Excel e Power Point;
Inglês Avançado e Espanhol desejável.
Power BI é um diferencial.
Local de trabalho: Sorocaba.Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:
Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Cumprir os princípios gerais do comportamento pessoal e profissional contidos no Código de Ética e Conduta da empresa, visando garantir uma atuação ética e sustentável por todos, observando as leis, regulamentos locais, internacionais, políticas e valores da empresa.

Domínio de metodologias de vendas complexas (comoSPIN Selling, Challenger Sale ou GPCTBA).

title: Pessoa analista de desenvolvimento php laravel pleno

title: Analista sr de finanças/controladoria para área de ti
description:
Se você tem paixão por tecnologia, visão estratégica e experiência em projetos de arquitetura empresarial, essa oportunidade pode ser para você.
Atividades:
Como Analista Sênior de Finanças e Controladoria, você será responsável por conduzir análises financeiras profundas e oferecer insights estratégicos que suportem decisões de negócio, garantindo precisão, integridade e conformidade dos processos financeiros. Ter conhecimento prático de infraestrutura, cloud e serviços de TI será um diferencial para compreender melhor as dinâmicas dos contratos sob sua responsabilidadeRequisitos:
Experiência sólida em Finanças, Controladoria e Controlling;
Vivência com contratos e fornecedores de TI, incluindo gestão de SLAs e compliance.
Atuação prévia com budgets relevantes e controles financeiros robustos.
Excel avançado, Power BI e ferramentas financeiras, SAP.
Conhecimento de processos de compras, jurídico e procurement.
Desejável entendimento de Infraestrutura, Cloud e contratos de serviços de TI.

title: Representante comercial
description:

title: Especialista treinamento manufatura - jundiaí

Operando 56 unidades de manufatura e 249 centros de distribuição, nossos mais de 97 mil funcionários nos permitem representar mais de 169 marcas líderes nos diferentes territórios em que estamos presentes. Acompanhar e garantir a execução do PAT (Plano Anual de Treinamento) em suas unidades.Requisitos do Perfil:

title: Especialista de automação e ia
description:
Vaga: Especialista de Automação e IALocal:Passo Fundo/RS - Vaga presencial️ Principais Responsabilidades
Desenvolver e implementar soluções de automação e IA para melhorar a eficiência e produtividade da organização, fazendo monitoramento destas soluções para garantir sua estabilidade e desempenho.
Projetar e desenvolver modelos de aprendizado de máquina e redes neurais para resolver problemas complexos.
Desenvolver fluxos de automação com ferramentas como Ui Path, Power Automate, N8 N e Copilot Studio.
Integrar soluções de automação e IA com sistemas existentes.
Analisar grandes conjuntos de dados para identificar padrões e tendências.
Desenvolver modelos de previsão e classificação para tomar decisões informadas.
Realizar testes e validações de modelos para garantir sua precisão e eficácia.
Realizar atualizações e melhorias contínuas nas soluções.
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de negócios e tecnologia para entender as necessidades e desenvolver soluções personalizadas.
Comunicar complexos conceitos técnicos de forma clara e eficaz para stakeholders não técnicos.
Fornecer treinamento e suporte para usuários finais.
Realizar pesquisas e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias e técnicas de automação e IA.
Avaliar e implementar novas ferramentas e tecnologias para melhorar a eficiência e produtividade.
Participar de conferências e eventos para se manter atualizado com as últimas tendências e avanços.
Gerenciar projetos de automação e IA garantindo que sejam concluídos dentro do prazo, orçamento e alcançando os ganhos esperados
Definir metas e objetivos claros para os projetos.
Garantir conformidade com políticas de segurança da informação, especialmente em ambientes com dados sensíveis ou críticoConhecimentos Específicos
Conhecimento em linguagens de programação como Python, Java, C++ e R.
Entendimento de algoritmos de aprendizado de máquina, como regressão, classificação, agrupamento e redes neurais.
Entendimento de bibliotecas e frameworks populares, como Tensor Flow, Py Torch, Scikit-learn e Keras.
Habilidade para lidar com grandes análises e conjuntos de dados, conhecimento em bancos de dados e ferramentas de processamento e análise de dados.
Conhecimento avançado em matemática, incluindo álgebra linear, estatística, probabilidade e cálculo.
Conhecimento de redes neurais artificiais, incluindo arquitetura, treinamento e aplicação.
Entendimento do Processamento de Linguagem Natural de conceitos como tokenização, análise sintática e embeddings de palavras.
Conhecimento de técnicas de visão computacional, incluindo extração de características, detecção de objetos e reconhecimento de padrões.
Compreensão das implicações éticas da IA, incluindo questões como privacidade, viés algorítmico e impacto social.Formação Acadêmica
Ensino superior completo em áreas de Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia ou correlatas.
Pós-graduação / Cursos de IA em andamento nas áreas afins de Ciência de Dados, RPA, Agentes ou Automação de Processo
